Cast Your Vote to See Current Results athttp://www.cnn.com/HEALTH/9702/weed.wars/get.interactive/poll/poll.html

What I find most impressive and encouraging about this poll is not so much the results (It does not pretend to be a scientific sampling.) but rather that the respondents seem to understand the situation. Medical access will lead to legalization of marijuana, because it will conclusively demonstrate that marijuana is not the dangerous drug that prohibitionists claim it to be. This has nothing to do with other drugs. This is a complete repudiation of the prohibitionist party line.

Do you think that some states' decision to allow marijuana to be used for medical purposes will lead to the drug's full legalization?

Yes: 80 percent (17607 votes)     No: 19 percent (4317 votes)

Do you think "medicinal marijuana" would open the doors for the legalization of other illicit drugs such as heroin?

Yes: 6 percent (1375 votes)            No: 93 percent (20590 votes)

Do you support the use of marijuana for medical purposes?

Yes: 96 percent (21258 votes)         No: 3 percent  (852 votes)
